key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:00D0
name: start_or_queue_device_request
description: Handles a device command: for command zero it either queues a request by filling its fields with default values and a sequence number, or, when no request is pending, allocates a message through the library and records an error code on failure. Any other command code records an error.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:00DE
name: open_audio_device_request
description: Checks a request counter and, when it is zero, opens a request on the audio device through an exec library call, recording an error code if the open or allocation fails. Otherwise it fills in a new request and queues it.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0110
name: allocate_request_message
description: Records a request type and a data pointer, allocates a message through an exec library call, and records an error code on failure. On success it counts the request, fills its default fields, and clears a flag bit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:014E
name: update_device_state_fields
description: Stores an input value into a structure, increments counters in it, copies a counter into a second structure, writes fixed words and bytes there, and clears a flag bit in the first structure.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01A0
name: set_request_status_and_clear
description: Stores the low byte of the data register in a request status field and sets the request's pointer field to minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01AE
name: queue_pending_request
description: Checks a device flag and whether the request's value matches the pending entry. When it matches it updates the request's fields, otherwise it links the request into a pending list and adjusts a counter, then sets the status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01E0
name: link_request_into_queue
description: Compares a request with the pending entry and either updates its nibble fields from the pending data or links it into a queue. The facts record writes to the interrupt enable register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0222
name: update_or_link_request
description: Copies the pending value and nibble fields into the request when they differ, otherwise links the request into a queue and adjusts a counter. The facts record writes to the interrupt enable register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:026A
name: copy_byte_and_split_nibbles
description: Copies a byte from one structure to another, stores its low and high nibbles in two bytes of the destination, clears a status byte, and calls another routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0290
name: validate_and_split_speech_text
description: Walks the pending request list, checks the request's rate, pitch, flag and volume fields against fixed ranges, and copies valid values into the device state. It then splits the request's text at commas, hyphens and spaces, and handles errors through the status byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:02F2
name: validate_narrator_request_fields
description: Checks a request's rate, pitch, flag, frequency and volume fields against fixed ranges and copies valid values into the device state; out-of-range values produce an error status. It then splits the request text at delimiter characters.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:030C
name: finish_matching_requests
description: Visits pending entries and calls a routine for each whose tag matches the caller's. It then decrements a counter and, when it reaches zero, calls two library routines and returns a status derived from the result.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0332
name: decrement_counter_and_close
description: Decrements a counter in a structure and, when it reaches zero, calls the library's free-memory and close-device routines through the library base, and optionally calls another routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:036E
name: dispatch_request_by_index
description: Calls one of eight handlers from a table, selected by an index in the request; an index outside that range records an error status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:038E
name: unlink_and_free_request
description: If a counter field in the request is zero, unlinks the request from its list, calls the library routines that release it, and returns a stored value. Otherwise it sets a flag bit in the request and returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:03AE
name: unlink_and_release_node
description: Unlinks a node from its list, calls a library routine to release it, and returns a value stored in the node.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:03F4
name: handle_request_state_transition
description: Sets a request's state field and dispatches on its value: states six and seven update device flags and call library routines, states eight and one run a handler twice, and state two matches the request against a pending entry before queuing it. Any other state is passed to a library routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:046C
name: mark_request_state_seven
description: Clears a device flag bit, sets the request state to seven, and calls two library routines to signal the change.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:04A8
name: mark_request_state_six
description: Sets a device flag bit, sets the request state to six, calls a library routine, and clears the request's status byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:04E6
name: set_flag_then_clear
description: Sets bit seven in a byte of the structure, calls two other routines, then clears that bit again.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0510
name: set_flag_clear_then_call
description: Sets bit seven in a byte of the structure, calls another routine, clears the bit, clears a status byte in a second structure, and calls another routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0540
name: process_pending_list_entries
description: Calls a routine when a device field is set, increments a busy counter, calls a routine for each entry in a linked list, then decrements the counter and writes the interrupt enable register when it reaches zero. The facts record interrupt-register writes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0570
name: decrement_counter_and_set_global
description: Decrements a byte counter in the global variable area and, if the previous value was less than one, writes a constant to the interrupt enable register, as recorded in the facts.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0584
name: remove_request_from_list_safely
description: Disables interrupts while it searches a request list for the given request. When the request is found it removes it and sets its status, then decrements the busy counter and calls a routine to finish.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05B0
name: remove_request_from_list
description: Searches a linked list for the given request; if it is found, removes it and sets its status to a fixed error value. It then decrements a busy counter and calls a routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05BE
name: unlink_request_and_complete
description: Unlinks a request from its list, sets its status to a fixed error value, decrements a busy counter, and calls a routine to finish.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05E8
name: decrement_counter_and_set_global
description: Decrements a byte counter held in a structure and, if the previous value was less than one, writes a constant to the interrupt enable register, as recorded in the facts.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0600
name: reject_request_with_status
description: Stores a fixed error status in the request and calls a routine to report it.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:060C
name: complete_request_with_status
description: Sets the request's status to zero and calls a routine to finish it.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0616
name: clear_flags_and_call_handler
description: Clears a flag bit in a structure, clears a byte in the request, and calls a handler through a library base.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0710
name: validate_request_fields_and_split
description: Checks a request's numeric fields against fixed ranges and, when they are valid, copies them into the device state. It then splits the request text at commas, hyphens and spaces; out-of-range values produce an error status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0744
name: check_input_range_then_split
description: Checks an input value against a fixed upper limit and, when it passes, copies it and the request's numeric fields into the device state before splitting the request text at delimiters.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:075E
name: check_input_limit_then_split
description: Checks an input value against a second fixed upper limit and, when it passes, copies it and the request's numeric fields into the device state before splitting the request text at delimiters.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:077E
name: store_word_then_split_text
description: Stores an input value in the request's field, checks two more request fields against fixed ranges, and copies the request's numeric fields into the device state. It then splits the request text at delimiter characters and reports the result status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0798
name: store_flag_then_split_text
description: Stores an input value in a device field, checks a range on another request field and a flag field, copies the request's numeric fields into the device state, and then splits the request text at delimiter characters.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:07AC
name: check_upper_limit_then_split
description: Checks an input value against a fixed upper limit, stores it in the device state, validates a flag field, and then splits the request text at delimiter characters.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:07C6
name: check_volume_then_split_text
description: Rejects an input value above a fixed limit, stores the value as a volume-style byte in the device state, copies the request's text fields and splits the text at delimiter characters.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0846
name: set_task_priority_and_split
description: Looks up a task, frees storage and sets the task priority through exec library calls according to the facts, then copies the request's fields and splits its text at delimiter characters.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:08E6
name: copy_counter_and_set_status
description: Copies a count field from one structure slot to another, stores the low byte of the data register as a status byte, and calls a routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:08EE
name: clear_counter_and_set_status
description: Clears a count field in a structure, stores the low byte of the data register as a status byte, and calls a routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0900
name: split_text_at_delimiters
description: Scans backwards through the request text for a comma, hyphen or space and records the split position in the request, then runs a completion path that calls library routines and returns a status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0930
name: find_space_split_position
description: Scans backwards through the request text for a space character to choose a split point, falling back to a computed position when none is found, then runs the completion path that calls library routines and returns a status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0956
name: split_text_and_complete
description: Stores half of a count in a request field, scans the request text for a delimiter, and runs the completion path that calls library routines and returns a status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0CF0
name: setup_speech_request_buffers
description: Clears per-request fields, stores a mode byte and a pointer taken from the request, and calls a library routine. When a flag is clear it allocates a buffer and copies a template table into it, returning an error code if the allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0D46
name: allocate_speech_buffer_copy
description: Stores a mode byte from the request, allocates a buffer through an exec library call, and sets up its message port and signal fields. When the lookup entry is present it copies the request template into the buffer, returning an error code when allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0D68
name: create_speech_iorb_request
description: Stores a request pointer and sets up its message port and signal fields, then allocates a buffer and copies the request template into it when the lookup entry is valid. The facts record the text Speech IORB.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0DBE
name: allocate_request_template_copy
description: Stores a mode byte in the request, allocates a buffer through an exec library call, and copies a 34-word template into it, returning an error code when allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0DDE
name: copy_word_table_to_buffer
description: Stores a buffer pointer in a global slot, then for a count taken from a byte in the structure copies a table of 34 words into the buffer and again into a position 34 words further along, once per iteration.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0E14
name: release_request_resources
description: Stores a value in the request, calls a library routine to complete the request, frees the buffers and ports it allocated, clears a word, and returns the combined result.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0E24
name: handle_io_and_free_resources
description: Stores a value in the request, calls a library routine, and then frees the buffers and the message port and signal according to the facts; it clears a word and returns a combined result. The facts list the DoIO, FreeMem and FreeSignal exec routines.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0F68
name: match_character_pairs_in_table
description: Returns the input unchanged when a count field is not positive. Otherwise it clears three buffers and scans the request text character by character, matching character pairs against a table of 112 entries in global data.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0F72
name: translate_text_to_speech_codes
description: Converts the request text into speech-code buffers: it clears three output buffers, matches each character or character pair against a 112-entry table, writes the matched codes, sets flag bits for two special codes, and ends the buffers with a marker byte when the text runs out.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0FE4
name: translate_text_pair_step
description: Handles one step of the text-to-speech-code translation: it treats digit characters specially, looks up the current character pair in the 112-entry table, writes the matched code or flags into the output buffers, and moves to the next character.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0FF8
name: translate_text_char_step
description: Handles one character of the text-to-speech-code translation: it looks up the character pair in a table, writes the matched code into the output buffer, and ends the buffers with a marker byte when the text is exhausted.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1026
name: advance_text_translation_step
description: Advances the text-to-speech-code translation by one character, writing matched codes, flag bits or the end marker to the output buffers, and returns the updated position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1064
name: apply_special_code_then_lookup
description: Sets flag bits in the output buffers for two special codes, then looks up the next character pair in the 112-entry table and writes its code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1074
name: translate_text_special_step
description: Handles a special marker in the text-to-speech-code translation, then looks up the next character pair in the 112-entry table and writes its code into the output buffers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1084
name: emit_speech_code_byte
description: Writes one speech-code byte into the output buffer, advances the output position, and continues the translation until the buffer limit or end of text is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10AA
name: translate_text_main_loop
description: Runs the main text-to-speech-code loop: it reads the next character pair from the request, matches it against the 112-entry table, and writes the code or flags for each character until the text ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10C2
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10CC
name: emit_speech_terminator_bytes
description: Writes the end marker bytes into the three output buffers at the current position and stores the resulting length.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10D8
name: emit_marker_and_length
description: Writes a marker code and end bytes into the output buffers at the current position, and stores the final length in the request.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1122
name: store_output_position
description: Stores the current output position in a field of the device state.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:112C
name: mark_stress_flags_in_codes
description: Walks the speech-code buffers and sets flag bits on codes that match patterns in the flag table, using the codes that precede them. The pass ends at the marker byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:118E
name: mark_stress_flags_forward
description: Walks the speech-code buffers forward and sets flag bits on codes whose table flags match the preceding codes, stopping at the marker byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:119E
name: mark_stress_flags_pass_two
description: Walks the speech-code buffers and sets flag bits on codes according to the table flags of the preceding code, as a second pass over the same buffers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:11BC
name: mark_segment_flag_bits
description: Walks the code buffers and sets bit 128 on each segment, then fills the segments that follow with flag bits derived from the preceding segment's flags. Segments whose table flags mark them as boundary codes are skipped.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:121A
name: mark_segment_flag_span
description: Sets flag bits across a span of the code buffers, deriving the bit pattern from the segment at the span start and stopping when the span is covered.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1262
name: mark_segment_flag_tail
description: Continues the segment flag marking over the code buffers, setting the span flags and returning when the terminator byte is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12CC
name: mark_segment_flag_run
description: Sets flag bits across a run of segments in the code buffers, deriving them from the preceding segment, and returns when the marker byte is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12D6
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12D8
name: apply_matching_speech_rules
description: Walks a table of three-character speech rules against the text buffer. For each rule whose pattern matches, it calls a routine to check the surrounding context and, when the context fits, writes the rule's replacement codes into the output, then continues the scan until the marker byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1324
name: match_rule_context_and_apply
description: Checks a rule's left and right context characters against the text. When both match it applies the rule's replacement bytes and their follow-up bytes to the output; otherwise it moves on to the next rule in the chain.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13C2
name: scan_rule_chain_for_match
description: Scans a chain of speech rules for one whose pattern matches the text at the current position, then checks its context and applies its replacement codes; the scan ends at the marker byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13D6
name: continue_rule_chain_scan
description: Continues scanning the speech-rule chain from the current rule, matching patterns and their context, and applying replacements until the chain or the text ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13E4
name: test_bit_with_table_lookup
description: Reads a byte from a buffer and a word from a table indexed by a word, modifies that word according to flag bits in the byte, and stops when a specific bit is set or the buffer's terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1412
name: insert_byte_shifting_buffers
description: When the output count is below its limit, increments it and shifts the bytes at the insertion point one place toward the end of three buffers. It then writes the register byte into the gap and zeroes the two companion bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1428
name: shift_bytes_and_clear_fields
description: Increments a word counter in a structure and shifts bytes backward in three buffers by a computed count, then writes a byte from a register and two zero bytes at the new ends of the buffers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1454
name: call_seven_routines_in_order
description: Calls seven routines in sequence and returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1472
name: clear_entry_flags_set_head
description: Walks an eight-byte-entry table from its head until the sentinel, clearing the seventh byte of each entry, then sets the head entry's seventh byte to 160.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:148A
name: clear_entries_until_match
description: Clears the seventh byte of eight-byte table entries until it reaches the entry whose first byte matches the argument, then sets the head entry's seventh byte to 160.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1492
name: adjust_segment_timing_values
description: Walks three parallel buffers of speech segments: for a punctuation code it splits a combined timing value between two neighbours, for flagged codes it halves a timing field, and for codes with a table flag it looks up a replacement value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:14B2
name: adjust_segment_timing_fields
description: Applies the same segment timing adjustments as its sibling routine, splitting values between neighbouring segments and looking up replacement values from a table for flagged codes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:14E6
name: apply_timing_table_to_segments
description: Walks the speech segments, looking up a replacement timing value for each flagged code, splitting values between neighbours for punctuation codes, and setting a stress-type field from the segment flags.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1510
name: apply_timing_flags_to_segments
description: Walks the speech segments using the flag bits of each code to set timing values and stress-type fields, splitting combined values for punctuation codes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1558
name: set_segment_stress_levels
description: Sets stress-type bits in the segment field from the flag bits of each code, then continues through the segments until the terminator byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1564
name: set_segment_stress_pattern
description: Sets stress-type bits in the segment field from the flag bits of each code, with a different mapping from the sibling routine, until the terminator byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1572
name: set_default_segment_stress
description: Sets a default stress-type bit in each segment field and then applies the flag-derived stress values to the segments that follow.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:157C
name: copy_segments_with_stress_flags
description: Copies speech segments into the output buffers, setting stress-type fields from the flag bits of each code and splitting combined values for punctuation codes, until the terminator byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1586
name: allocate_frame_buffers_from_total
description: Sums the length values of the segment table up to its end marker, stores the total and the derived buffer size in the device state, and allocates the frame buffer through an exec library call, plus a second buffer when a flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15A0
name: allocate_frame_buffers_for_size
description: Stores a size derived from the input value in the device state and allocates a frame buffer through an exec library call, plus a second buffer when a flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15C2
name: allocate_secondary_frame_buffer
description: Stores the input pointer in the device state, and when a flag is set allocates a secondary buffer through an exec library call and records its pointer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15E0
name: fill_frames_for_segments
description: Expands each speech segment into eight-byte frame records, copying the segment's table parameters into the frame and setting pitch and flag bits, then writes a terminator record at the end of the table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:160A
name: fill_frames_from_code_stream
description: Reads the speech-code stream and writes eight-byte frame records for each code, copying table parameters and flag bits into the frames and ending the table with a terminator record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:16B8
name: fill_frames_from_table_values
description: Writes eight-byte frame records from table values for each code, adjusting parameters by the segment flags and ending the record list with a terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:172A
name: interpolate_frame_values
description: Smooths a parameter across neighbouring frames: for each frame pair whose code flags allow it, it blends the two values with a five-step weighting derived from the frame length.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1762
name: interpolate_frame_pair_values
description: Applies the same five-step weighting between neighbouring frame values as its sibling routine, using a table of weights and the frame lengths.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:177A
name: interpolate_frame_sequence
description: Walks a sequence of frames and blends each frame's values toward its neighbours using five-step weights, moving to the next frame after each step.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17A8
name: interpolate_linear_frame_run
description: Interpolates a run of frame values linearly from one end to the other, stepping through the frame records and stopping at the terminator code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17D2
name: interpolate_linear_frame_step
description: Performs one linear interpolation step across a run of frame values, weighting each value by a table entry and moving to the next frame.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17D6
name: build_frame_extents
description: Writes frame records for a code with a flag-selected pattern, marks extents with sentinel bytes, and fills the remaining frame slots of the segment.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:181E
name: compute_frame_amplitude_values
description: Computes per-frame amplitude and pitch-related values from the code tables, writing them into the frame records and marking the frames that carry flags.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1844
name: distribute_frame_durations
description: Distributes each segment's frame count across eight-byte frame records, computing the split between neighbouring segments from their table values, then writes the frame data and sentinel bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:186E
name: fill_frame_run_from_codes
description: Writes a run of eight-byte frame records for each speech code, deriving the run length from the code tables and the neighbouring codes, and ends the output with the terminator byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1880
name: fill_frame_run_with_flags
description: Writes a run of frame records for each code, choosing the run length and sentinel fields from the code's flag bits and the next code, until the terminator byte is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:18B8
name: fill_frame_extents_pass
description: Writes frame extents for each code according to its flag bits, computing the run lengths from neighbouring code values and marking the record slots with sentinel bytes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:190E
name: fill_trailing_frame_run
description: Fills the last frame run of a segment from the neighbouring code values, writing the frame records and sentinel bytes until the terminator byte is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)[a]/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:191A
name: fill_frame_run_tail
description: Completes the frame records for the final segments, writing the remaining slots and sentinel bytes, and returns when the terminator byte is reached.
